title: “God Still Has the Final Say — Isaiah 46:10”:
paragraphs: “God Still Has the Final Say — Isaiah 46:10”:
God is not pacing heaven, nervous about your future.
He already stands where your story ends.

That’s the weight of Isaiah 46:10 — declaring the end from the beginning. Before your heartbreak happened, He knew. Before the door closed, He knew. Before the betrayal, the diagnosis, the silence, the delay—
And He still called His purpose good.

That does not mean the pain is fake.
It means the pain is not final.

People may speak curses over your life.
Fear may preach disaster.
Your own failures may whisper, “It’s over.”
But none of them sit on the throne.

And when God has the final say, shame does not win. Sin does not win. Delay does not win. Even death does not get the last word—because Jesus stepped into our ruin, carried our sin, died our death, and rose with the verdict of Heaven in His hands.

So no, your story is not finished because it got dark.
It’s not finished because you fell.
It’s not finished because you cannot see the next page.

God is still writing.
And He never loses the pen.
Repent where you have doubted Him. Trust where you have tried to control everything. Come back to Christ, because the safest place for an uncertain future is in the hands of a sovereign Savior.

God still has the final say.
Not your past.
Not your fear.
Not the devil.
Not the grave.
